digest.component_or_area: LLM provider factory and runner configuration
propositions: The runner refuses valid base_url and api_key configuration despite documentation and config parsing support, surfacing a capability gap versus langgraph.

An OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Ollama, LMStudio, vLLM) requires withdrawn strict json_schema_output capability to avoid silent wrong answers or opaque errors, necessitating a profile override at the provider level.
The openai builder must register conditionally only when base_url is configured to preserve lazy model-string resolution for bare openai strings and keep the openai SDK optional.
A custom base_url is provider configuration not selection; it must not override an explicit REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER and must work alongside anthropic/other providers.
The profile override must apply only to supports_json_schema_output while preserving other capabilities like supports_tools through a rebar OpenAIProvider subclass.
